periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the median facial plane, pointing towards the ventrolateral aspect of the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced inferior tapering with the centroid shifted towards the upper margin, creating a teardrop-like extension towards the lower cheek.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate separation distance, approximately equivalent to the transverse width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and hemispherical apex profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive rufous-brown soil staining visible across the ventral and posterior white fur regions of the lower abdomen and rump.
